Aggregate multiple confusion matrices

Source: R/confusion_matrix.R
dot-aggregate_confusion_matrices.Rd

Take element-wise minimum across multiple confusion iterations

Usage

.aggregate_confusion_matrices(cmat_list, method = "min")

Arguments

cmat_list

List of confusion matrices (from multiple sampling iterations)

method

Aggregation method: "min" or "mean"

Value

Aggregated confusion matrix
